title: The supersymmetric Scarf I Hamiltonian with reflections and its discrete para-Bannai--Ito version
summary: The para-Bannai--Ito polynomials are orthogonal on a Bannai--Ito bi-lattice that is \emph{two-sided} --- it extends on both sides of a central value $c_0$ --- and depend, besides the two grid parameters, on an isospectral deformation parameter. Their Jacobi matrix $J$ is invariant under the reversal of the sites at one value of that parameter only, the persymmetric point, and we determine its continuum limit there.
